promptTemplate:
Run the VM catalog sweep for: {{blueprints}}
Boxes: {{boxes}}
Catalog: eshtek/hexos-vm-catalog @ {{catalogRef}} (specs in _tests/). Platform: eshtek/hexos-platform @ {{platformRef}}.
Why: {{reason}}

1. Health-check the dev runner first (dashboard :3333, main-backend, BOTH box instances, Docker) and fix it before anything else.
2. Sync the catalog on the dev main from the catalog checkout at the ref above (Admin > VM Blueprints > Sync Catalog) so every box installs from it. Un-park any parked blueprint in the list ONCE before the first run and re-park after the LAST run, never in between.
3. cd packages/dev/scripts/vm-catalog-sweep; python3 plan.py <port> plan.json --catalog=<catalog checkout> --only=<ids>; run one sweep.py per box concurrently (sequential inside a box), --baseline = that box's previous results file, and ONE shared --run-id for the sweep.
4. Do NOT edit packages/backend while a sweep runs: bun --watch hot-restarts the local backends and kills live installs.
5. Review every soft-complete's console frame into reviewed.json: an installed greeter or lock screen = unmonitored, a live installer / welcome screen / unconfigured host = broken.
6. python3 submit.py per box with --plan plan.json --reviewed reviewed.json; results and frames appear at {{resultsUrl}}.
7. Report the matrix (report.py) and every regression against the baseline. Never park a blueprint automatically: recommend it with the evidence, a human confirms in a catalog PR.
